|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ env | grep AMBIENT
|1ISH_AMBIENT=invalid-name
|TMP_AMBIENT_VAR=ambient
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $

== frame after_unset cursor=7,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ env | grep AMBIENT
|1ISH_AMBIENT=invalid-name
|TMP_AMBIENT_VAR=ambient
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ unset TMP_AMBIENT_VAR; env | grep AMBIENT
|1ISH_AMBIENT=invalid-name
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 env
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@4 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 unset
@7 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
